column1: ## Repository Table R15. Direction-independent adaptive allele score separation

## Description: CH is computed on two one-dimensional groups of raw selected and alternative allele log probabilities. It measures separation irrespective of direction. A large value can accompany systematic preference for the alternative allele and is not evidence of selection prediction.
## Missing values: NA means unavailable or not applicable, never a zero score. Numeric values retain source precision.
## Column 1 | Model | Evaluated checkpoint display name, harmonized with the figures.
## Column 2 | Locus pairs | Locus pairs for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 3 | Calinski–Harabasz index | Calinski–Harabasz index for the observation defined in the table description.
